raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-18 payments-source change now sends amount corrections as a repeated txn_id with record_version=2, and silver_transactions keeps both versions. The fix is to keep only the latest version per txn_id (highest record_version, then latest ingest_ts) before applying the POSTED filter, so a correction that reverses a transaction is also respected.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) latest WHERE latest.rn = 1 AND latest.status = 'POSTED';"}}
